I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team: "Thanks, Marcus, noted: the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 21 December. I haven't done anything else with it."

He said no action was needed, so I didn't set a reminder, add it to the calendar or send any mail. I also didn't save it anywhere outside that thread. The deadline is a date, not a money figure, so it was fine to repeat in the team channel.
